info.title: SweatCaster
info.description: SweatCaster API v1. Chat success is text/event-stream. JSON errors use the error envelope. Chat does not use HTTP 503. v2 model, chat, and agent hub routes are implemented on this process. v1 chat still does not use HTTP 503. Hub revisions are retained for 100 updates, then a client must resync.

403.description: Foreign Origin. The body is the error envelope.

200.description: Inbox clips. Empty list when the inbox is empty.

SSE stream. Each frame is data: {JSON}\n\n. The JSON type is only tool_status, text, or done. This status is also used when the assistant container is down, times out before the stream, returns a non-200 status, or names a different model. Those cases are one text frame and one done frame. They are not HTTP 503. A socket drop after the stream has started still begins as 200 and may end without done.

401.description: Missing or wrong bearer token. Sent before the stream starts.

403.description: Foreign Origin. Sent before the stream starts.

422.description: The chat JSON failed parse_chat, or it was not a JSON object. Sent before the stream starts.

202.description: One job per clip. Processing has not finished.

404.description: A clip id is not in the inbox.

422.description: The JSON body failed the job rules. The body is the error envelope, not a validation detail array.

503.description: ffmpeg, ffprobe, Ollama, or Piper is not ready. No job is stored.

200.description: One job, including failed and cancelled jobs.
Cancel requested, or the job was already terminal.
Finished vertical MP4. Accept-Ranges is bytes.

206.description: A Range request. Content-Range is set. This is still video/mp4.

404.description: Unknown job, or the finished file is missing.

409.description: The job has no finished video yet.

200.description: Idempotent. Deletes only this job's generated files after the phone has saved its own copy. A second call removes nothing more.

409.description: The job is not finished, or a file is busy or linked outside the job folder.

422.description: saved is not true, or the body has another field.

schema.title: Response Remove Video Api V2 Jobs  Job Id  Video Delete

200.description: Configured folders in config order. file_count is video files before the 180 second filter. No paths. ready means the file list can be paged. indexing means a background probe is still filling metadata. Folder names are not rewritten.

One folder. The v1 list still stops at 200 clips across folders. Clips longer than 180 seconds are omitted. A page does not hash the catalog and does not probe files outside that page. The same file id is reused when two roots open one volume file. POST /api/v1/jobs still takes clip_ids.

422.description: Bad root id, limit, or cursor.

parameters.name: root_id
parameters.description: Id from GET /api/v2/clip-roots. It is the config index, not a path.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor from the previous page. A relative name inside that folder, not a path.

200.description: Local allowlist. Discovery does not download a model.

SSE. Each frame is data: {json} followed by a blank line. There is no event: line. Types are only tool_status, text, and done. done is once, last, and only after a finished reply. It carries an empty content, message_id, and the actual model_id. usage is omitted unless input_tokens, output_tokens, and elapsed_ms were all measured. A failure after the first byte closes without done.

schema.description: UTF-8 frames. JSON values match ChatV2Event.

401.description: Missing or wrong bearer token. Before admission.

404.description: model_id is a non-empty string outside qwen25-7b and llama31-8b. The id is not stored.

409.description: This pairing identity already used request_id. No replay.

422.description: Malformed body, unknown field, bad message or session, bad request_id, empty model_id, context with data, or a non-null parent.

503.description: The known tag is not installed, Ollama is offline, the assistant container did not answer, or the model queue is full. The id is not stored.

200.description: Read-only snapshot. Does not award XP or bump revision.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional. Omitted means 50. Integers 1 through 100. Anything else is 422.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque seq:id from next_cursor. A value that is not that shape is 422.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional. Omitted means 50. Integers 1 through 100. Anything else is 422.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque seq:id from next_cursor. A value that is not that shape is 422.

200.description: Curated memories for this agent. Empty until a curated row exists. Chat sessions are not listed.

schema.title: Response Delete Memory Api V2 Memory  Fact Id  Delete

200.description: A curated fact. It is not a chat turn. The same text and source return the existing id.

422.description: Missing text or source, or an extra field.

200.description: Only the named files under the documents folder. No home or Videos scan. Missing embedding is 503, not an empty success.

422.description: Missing paths, too many paths, or an extra field.

503.description: The local embedding files are not on disk. This call does not download them.

503.description: ComfyUI or its checkpoint is unavailable.

post.description: Generate a PNG through PC-local ComfyUI when the phone cannot render locally. The phone's LoRA is not transferred.

Response Code Workspace Apply Api V2 Code Proposals  Change Id  Apply Post

200.description: first_video only. earned_at is stored, not the clock at read time.
SSE comments are heartbeats. Data frames are hub_updated or resync_required. There is no chat done frame.

401.description: Missing or wrong bearer token. Before the stream.

422.description: The revision cursor is not an integer, or it is in the future. Before the stream.

parameters.name: after_revision
parameters.description: Omitted tails from the current revision and sends only later updates. A retained older revision yields one hub_updated for the latest revision, not a byte replay. A revision outside the retained window yields resync_required. A future revision is 422 before any SSE byte. The token is the Authorization header, never this query.

anyOf.description: Present only when status is failed. Codes stored by the job worker include PROCESSING_FAILED, CLIP_CHANGED, ENGLISH_REJECTED, DEPENDENCY_MISSING, and NOT_FOUND.

message.description: Required. Blank after trimming is rejected before the stream.

session_id.description: Optional. Omitted or null becomes an empty string. A non-empty value is at most 64 characters; each character is a Unicode letter, digit, underscore, or hyphen. The host forwards that string. Empty is not stored. A non-empty value is only a key in the container process for up to six redacted user lines. It is not a login and it is not written to disk.

ChatSseFrame.description: One SSE frame: data: {"type":"tool_status|text|done","content":"..."}\n\n. content is a string. It has no code field. done content is empty and is sent once only when the host finishes the generator. A tool exception or a mid-stream socket drop can end the body without done.

id.description: Opaque id. Supported values are qwen25-7b and llama31-8b. Not an enum.

model_id.description: Omitted means the configured default. An unknown string is HTTP 404, not a schema failure.

bot_id.description: Omitted: the server picks the hub role from the message. Known ids are the hub agent ids. An unknown string is HTTP 404. The id selects the orchestrator node. A style line cannot replace that node's checks.

system_prompt.description: Style only. The fixed security rules stay in front of it. When bot_id is also set, bot_id chooses the tool and this text only styles the reply.

ChatImage.description: One image. No URL. qwen25-7b and llama31-8b reject it. moondream-18 accepts it when that Ollama tag is already installed. Bytes are not stored.

indexing.description: True while a background pass is probing files that this response did not need.

bearerAuth.description: Pairing token. Required on every /api/v1 route except GET /api/v1/health.
